_: THE BOULDER (GDD 6 packing test). Subdivides ONE level and then goes terminal: a single clean cross, and nothing finer. 'Solid, 4-way, this will take work' (GDD 4.6.2).
_cost: resistance 20 against a 1 HP pickaxe means the first break costs twenty strikes with NOTHING happening in between -- which is the read. Its total clearing cost is close to dirt's, but dirt gives you a break every strike or two and this gives you nothing for twenty. The wall is in the pacing, not the total.
_untuned: GDD 8 lists resistance values as expected to move under playtest. This one is ordered, not tuned.
_gate: Resistance is tool-relative (GDD 4.3.1), so this is also a progression gate at zero extra cost: unbreakable until you buy the drill.
